services.desc: We carry up to 5 passengers plus the pilot during each balloon flight. Larger groups MAY be accommodated in multiple balloons - dependent on availability of additional aircraft. Complimentary ground transportation from our meeting location to the flight area and back to your vehicle post flight. Enjoy the same flight as a traditional Balloon Adventure but have the entire gondola to yourselves. There will be no other clients on-board, just your party and the pilot.
